using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using System;
using System.Diagnostics;
using System.Threading;
using Volo.Abp.Cli.Commands;
using Xunit;

namespace Volo.Abp.Cli.Tests
{
    public class SuiteCommandTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public void KillSuite_LogsInformation_WhenProcessIsKilled()
        {
            // Arrange
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger<SuiteCommand>>();
            var suiteCommand = new SuiteCommand(
                new AbpNuGetIndexUrlService(),
                new PackageVersionCheckerService(),
                new CmdHelper(),
                new AuthService(),
                new CliHttpClientFactory(),
                new SuiteAppSettingsService()
            );
            suiteCommand.Logger = loggerMock.Object;

            // Act
            suiteCommand.KillSuite();

            // Assert
            loggerMock.Verify(l => l.LogInformation("Suite closed."), Times.Once);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void KillSuite_LogsInformation_WhenExceptionIsThrown()
        {
            // Arrange
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger<SuiteCommand>>();
            var suiteCommand = new SuiteCommand(
                new AbpNuGetIndexUrlService(),
                new PackageVersionCheckerService(),
                new CmdHelper(),
                new AuthService(),
                new CliHttpClientFactory(),
                new SuiteAppSettingsService()
            );
            suiteCommand.Logger = loggerMock.Object;

            // Act
            suiteCommand.KillSuite();

            // Assert
            loggerMock.Verify(l => l.LogInformation(It.IsAny<string>()), Times.Once);
        }
    }
}

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Net.Http;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Volo.Abp.Cli.Http;
using Volo.Abp.DependencyInjection;

namespace Volo.Abp.Cli.Services
{
    public class AbpNuGetIndexUrlService : ITransientDependency
    {
        private readonly ICliHttpClientFactory _cliHttpClientFactory;

        public AbpNuGetIndexUrlService(ICliHttpClientFactory cliHttpClientFactory)
        {
            _cliHttpClientFactory = cliHttpClientFactory;
        }

        public async Task<string> GetNuGetIndexUrlAsync()
        {
            var client = _cliHttpClientFactory.CreateClient();
            var response = await client.GetAsync("https://api.nuget.org/v3/index.json");
            response.EnsureSuccessStatusCode();
            var responseBody = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
            var nuGetIndex = JObject.Parse(responseBody);
            return nuGetIndex["resources"][0]["@id"].ToString();
        }
    }
}
